notes.title: Release Update: Yarn Guardians Launch Moved to August 14, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone, We have a small update: [i]Yarn Guardians[/i] will now launch on [b]August 14[/b].[/p][p]The reason? We're still finishing up localization, and we want [b]everyone around the world[/b] to have the [b]same great experience[/b] on day one – no matter which language they play in.[/p][p]The game is nearly done (and we're really proud of it!), but a few final touches are still in the works.[/p][p]The [b]demo is still live on Steam[/b], so feel free to jump in while you wait![/p][p]Thanks so much for your patience and support – it means the world to us. – The Yarn Guardians Team [/p]
